capabilities: Display an Overview, Focus, Schedule, and Metrics dashboard from daily notes
Parse daily note body sections for tasks, frogs, time blocks, and metrics
Track activity in an 84-day heatmap with stats like active days and tasks completed
Quick-capture inbox files via the Capture tab
Auto-refresh the dashboard 800ms after vault file changes
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a read-only dashboard over daily notes, not a command palette or command launcher.
extras: Users must build main.js from main.ts before the plugin loads; it expects a specific vault folder layout (00 Human/10 Daily Notes/YYYY-MM-DD.md) and sections in daily notes, so it is tied to the Kaymina-OS vault setup.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard that parses daily-note body sections into one live overview of focus, schedule, metrics, and activity.

relations.evidence: This plugin is meant to work with an vault using Gemini CLI

summary: Dashboard plugin that renders focus, tasks, schedule, metrics, and activity heatmap tabs from a fixed daily-note layout used by the Kaymina-OS vault.
